ambient: Somebody at the front turns a page over and the whole hall turns a page over.
The invigilator walks the aisle, passes you, and doesn't need to stop.
Chalk on a board behind you writes the time remaining and rubs it out.
description: A hall of desks and a paper you haven't prepared for, in a subject you did study, a long time ago, thoroughly. Everyone else started an hour ago. The questions are fair. You have been given the full time and the full time began before you arrived.
name: The Paper

looks: Question one is one you can do. You did it. It's still question one.
The questions are in your subject and in your year and in your handwriting.
Turn it over and the reverse is the same side.
objects.name: the paper

looks: All writing. None of them hurried.
You know several of them. They're the ages they were then.
The one beside you has finished and is waiting, politely, for you.
objects.name: the other candidates

weather: Still, and warm at the back of the neck, and quiet enough to hear paper.
